sb_prompt: COMPARE YOUR OPINIONS AND THOSE OF THE OTHER CALLER ON CAPITAL PUNISHMENT.  DO EITHER OF YOU THINK IT SHOULD BE RESTRICTED TO CERTAIN CRIMES OR CIRCUMSTANCES?  HOW DO THE POLICIES AND PRACTICES OF YOUR STATE FIT WITH YOUR OPINIONS?
raw_output:
ParticipantA: Hello!
ParticipantB: Hi there.
ParticipantA: Yeah, I'm calling 'cause I got that thing in the mail about comparing opinions on capital punishment.
ParticipantB: Oh, right. Yeah, I got that too.
ParticipantA: Cool. So, what's your take on it?
ParticipantB: Honestly? It's complicated. I mean, parts of it sit fine with me, you know? Like, the justice system got you a guy who murdered a kid? That just feels like... wrong.
ParticipantA: Yeah, I hear that. But other parts don't sit so good. You know my buddy Mark? He was a lawyer, used to do death penalty cases.
ParticipantB: Yeah, I know Mark.
ParticipantA: He did one for a guy who was on death row, never got executed. Guy was innocent. Mark said that's why he's all against it now. Said once you start killing, you can't stop.
ParticipantB: Hmm. That's a good point. I didn't think about the innocent part. I made up my mind years ago, actually.
ParticipantA: Oh? When was that?
ParticipantB: Maybe ten years ago? I just felt like... if you're guilty, you deserve justice, right? But if you're innocent, it's a mess. Still, I haven't changed my mind much.
ParticipantA: Fair enough. What about certain crimes? Should it be restricted?
ParticipantB: Yeah, definitely. Like, premeditated murder? That makes sense to me. But what about drug stuff? Or crimes of passion? That feels like overkill.
ParticipantA: Same here. I'd say only for heinous stuff. Like, killing more than one person, or kids.
ParticipantB: Exactly. My state... well, we use it for murder and treason mostly.
ParticipantA: What's our state?
ParticipantB: Ohio. We do it, but it's rare. Mostly for first-degree murder.
ParticipantA: That sounds about right. I'm from Michigan. We abolished it a few years back, I think?
ParticipantB: Wait, really? Didn't you say you were pro-death penalty earlier?
ParticipantA: I did. But now... after Mark told me that story, I'm leaning towards abolishing it. Or at least restricting it way down.
ParticipantB: See? That's why I said parts of it don't sit right. If the system can mess up, you don't want to be the one holding the gun.
ParticipantA: Yeah, that makes sense. So, you're sticking with it, but only for the worst crimes?
ParticipantB: Yeah. Only for the worst. Like, no more for drugs or theft. Just murder, maybe rape if there's no parole.
ParticipantA: Okay, I can work with that. My state abolished it for everyone, but I guess I'd be okay with bringing it back for, like, three strikes of murder?
ParticipantB: Three? Or one?
ParticipantA: One, if it's premeditated. If it's passion, maybe not.
ParticipantB: That's pretty reasonable. Most people don't think that way.
ParticipantA: True. It's a tough topic.
ParticipantB: Yeah, it is.
ParticipantA: Okay, well, I'll stop bugging you. Thanks for talking.
ParticipantB: You too. Good luck with that thing.
ParticipantA: Yeah. Bye.
ParticipantB: Bye.
